description: Artifact-bound whole-product journeys that are hermetic, bounded, shardable, and explicit about later release gates.

artifactContract.stageRootContract: A synthetic Cellar path below $HOME/coding/tmp; runtime authority remains in a separate isolated home.

proves: The host-target pd launcher and companion are executable staged artifacts built by the release builder.
The staged cargo passes the compiled pd batten verifier and its manifest hashes are recorded without file bodies.
doesNotProve: GitHub provenance, Developer ID signing, notarization, or a published release archive.
A pristine Homebrew installation or upgrade.

proves: The compiled launcher discovers staged tentacles, hooks, the public skill, and Pilot resources outside the source checkout.
Provider configuration points at a stable isolated home instead of the synthetic Cellar or source checkout.
doesNotProve: Real provider hook execution, provider authentication, macOS TCC consent, or background capture.

proves: The staged daemon reaches readiness on both its Unix socket and its published loopback TCP endpoint.
Health and version payloads identify the same live process over both transports.
doesNotProve: launchd supervision, a canonical port 9876 deployment, browser behavior, or remote networking.
Long-duration crash freedom under production state.

proves: The compiled CLI completes begin, plan set/check/read, note, file claim, and sitrep journeys against isolated durable state.
Two arbitrary fixture repositories remain distinct while a main checkout and linked worktree share one canonical repository family.
A forced daemon crash followed by restart preserves session, checked plan, note, claim, and worktree metadata readback.
doesNotProve: Cross-machine Relay replication, Chartroom authorization, GitHub delivery, or recovery of another owner.
The operator's canonical daemon or repository contents.

proves: The staged daemon survives a deterministic synthetic registry plus five bounded concurrent client loops hitting health, sessions, roadmap, Galaxy, and Fleet reads.
Every synthetic client has at most one in-flight refresh and state remains readable after the pressure sample.
doesNotProve: The installed 1.6 GB database, five real pd-console builds, FleetBar, approximately 28 panes per console, or two-second production cadence.
Hidden-pane inactivity or the absence of overlapping refreshes in pd-console itself; those are separately gated below.

proves: A staged daemon fails instead of displacing an unrelated listener on its requested port.
After the listener is released, a clean daemon can claim the same port and become ready.
doesNotProve: Canonical launchd duplicate-daemon repair or takeover of a half-alive installed process.

proves: An injected test failure still terminates the artifact daemon and removes the case-owned runtime directory.
Cleanup is checked, not inferred from a successful process exit.
doesNotProve: Cleanup after host power loss, runner termination, or SIGKILL of the test orchestrator itself.

proves: Known secret carriers and deterministic canaries emitted by a hostile fixture are redacted before durable suite logs are written.
The results artifact contains classifications and counts, not raw secret payloads.
doesNotProve: Perfect detection of every possible secret encoding or safety of unrelated GitHub Actions logs.

proves: The existing compiled CLI surface reconciler still drives or explicitly skips every top-level verb using the staged companion binary.
The Phase-1 suite composes the existing smoke instead of renaming or duplicating it.
doesNotProve: Deep product semantics for every CLI verb or safety of commands intentionally represented by explicit skips.

proves: The exact staged companion boots, answers a bounded workload, and exits cleanly through the existing packaged-binary soak.
The soak scratch prefix is explicitly under the suite's durable root.
doesNotProve: The release workflow's full 180-second timer window or issue 676's production-state crash profile.
The installed daemon stability gate below.

acceptance: A non-draft PR is created by the configured GitHub App with attributable agent and session receipts.
Review, required checks, protected queue, merged head, artifact provenance, and signatures are independently read back.
Relay and Chartroom authenticate through their durable production-shaped boundary.
Authorized write, durable readback, revocation, denial, and restart behavior are proven without exporting credentials.
A pristine supported host installs the published archive through the tap and finds every package resource.
An upgrade preserves durable authority state, migrates supported data, and removes versioned-keg references.
The signed installed daemon is supervised by launchd and FleetBar connects to the same healthy runtime over its intended surfaces.
Removed environment keys are absent, provider hooks are current, Relay connectivity is truthful, and health/Galaxy reads stay non-error.
A deterministic seeded high-cardinality or production-scale registry is exercised without copying production payloads into CI.
Five simultaneous pd-console client classes plus FleetBar sustain the production-shaped refresh period and approximately 28-pane request mix.
Per-client request counters prove bounded request rate, no overlapping refresh cycles, and no requests from hidden panes.
The daemon remains crash-free and responsive; roadmap status=all limit=2000, Galaxy, health, Fleet, and durable state readback remain successful.
An explicit app and instance allowlist is visible and enforced while capture continues in the background.
Picker alignment, cursor visibility, comments, pause, resume, stop, redaction, indexing, and cast export are directly evidenced.
Capture outside the allowlist and unconsented sources is denied.
Staging exercises the production Worker and durable storage topology with bounded synthetic data.
Request, storage, AI, retry, and failure costs are observable and stay within an explicit release budget.
